resources.string: Apps looking for testers show up here. Test them to earn DevCoins, then spend DevCoins to put your own app on the board.
Tests you join appear here with their tasks, the days you have left and what each one pays.
Apps you put up for testing appear here with their tester count and how far through the 14 days they are.
App inspector, APK analyzer, permission checker and device diagnostics run from here.
Testing work you complete builds your badge. Devices, reputation and account settings live here.
DevCoins reward real testing work: completed tasks, useful feedback and reproducible bug reports.
